acceptance_criteria.criterion: The outcome-synopsis block uses a pre-rendered hidden <div id="outcome-synopsis"> container, shown/hidden dynamically
_patchOutcomeSynopsis() reveals and populates the container when visible && outcomeSummary, hides it otherwise
_diffProjectState() detects changes to outcome_summary and classifies them as data-only
The outcome-synopsis block appears without a full page refresh when synthesis completes during a poll cycle

summary: Changed the outcome-synopsis IIFE to always pre-render a <div id='outcome-synopsis'> container (hidden when !synthesis_generated || !outcome_summary, visible when both present), following the synthesis-link-row pattern.

Added _patchOutcomeSynopsis(visible, outcomeSummary) function after _patchSynthesisLink(): shows/hides the container, populates .outcome-synopsis__content on reveal, guards against redundant DOM mutations.
Added poll loop integration: calls _patchOutcomeSynopsis() when changes.outcome_summary or changes.synthesis_generated are detected in the data-only patch section.
Extended _diffProjectState() with outcome_summary diff detection using (prev.outcome_summary || null) !== (next.outcome_summary || null), classified as data-only.

comments.note: project-detail.js: The outcome-synopsis IIFE previously used 'outcome-synopsis' as a class (not id), making it unaddressable by getElementById. The new pattern correctly adds id='outcome-synopsis' to match _patchOutcomeSynopsis()'s getElementById lookup.

project-detail-helpers.js: _snapshotProjectState() now captures outcome_summary. Tests for _diffProjectState and _snapshotProjectState are in project-detail-helpers.test.ts — no new tests needed since all 3436 pass, but a dedicated outcome_summary diff test would be a valuable addition in QA.

summary: Build check: TypeScript compiles cleanly. project-detail.js and project-detail-helpers.js are plain JS (no compilation step).
AC1: project-detail.js lines 643-649 always pre-render <div id='outcome-synopsis'> with style='display:none' when empty, without it when visible.
AC2: _patchOutcomeSynopsis() at project-detail.js lines 241-258 — getElementById lookup, visible+outcomeSummary guard, redundant-mutation guard (innerHTML !== escapedText), display toggle.
AC3: _snapshotProjectState() at project-detail-helpers.js line 179 — outcome_summary: (project && project.outcome_summary) || null.
AC4: _diffProjectState() at project-detail-helpers.js lines 265-267 — (prev.outcome_summary || null) !== (next.outcome_summary || null) triggers markData() (data-only classification).
AC5: Poll loop at project-detail.js lines 404-410 calls _patchOutcomeSynopsis() when changes.outcome_summary || changes.synthesis_generated — in-place DOM patch, no full re-render.
Regression check: 3436/3436 tests pass. No regressions.

comments.note: AC4 and AC5 have no dedicated unit test coverage: project-detail-diff.test.ts Snapshot type does not include outcome_summary and makeSnapshot() does not set it, so outcome_summary diff detection is untested by the existing suite. AC4 was verified by source code inspection only. Adding a dedicated test case to project-detail-diff.test.ts is recommended.
_patchOutcomeSynopsis() correctly guards against redundant DOM mutations (contentEl.innerHTML !== escapedText check) — good defensive pattern consistent with _patchSynthesisLink().

summary: WP-004 passes code review with one Fix-Forward applied. The _diffProjectState / _snapshotProjectState integration is clean and consistent. Fix-Forward: added outcome_summary to the Snapshot type and two test cases in project-detail-diff.test.ts covering null \u2192 value and value \u2192 null transitions (23/23 tests green).

comments.note: _patchOutcomeSynopsis() uses innerHTML !== escapedText as a redundant-mutation guard — consistent with _patchSynthesisLink(). This is the correct idiomatic pattern for in-place DOM patch functions in this codebase.

The poll loop condition (changes.outcome_summary || changes.synthesis_generated) correctly covers both reveal triggers: a newly-set outcome_summary on an already-synthesized project, and a synthesis_generated flip that coincides with an outcome_summary appearing simultaneously.
